pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with sharp to moderately jagged edge gradients on the upper flank and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more rounded geometries with lower-contrast edges on the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of high-luminance pathways forming a topological graph with frequent tri-node junctions. Pixel thickness is highest in the mid-flank regions and tapers slightly towards the cervical region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency 1D jagged contour visible along the upper neck and thoracic ridge, representing the mane silhouette.
